reason: Study 1 explicitly replicates Epley and Gilovich (2006, Study 2a) testing whether need for cognition correlates with susceptibility to self-generated anchors (p. 5, Section 4; p. 11, Section 4.3; the p. 16 locator falls in Study 2). In the Study 1 discussion, the authors explicitly conclude there were no correlations between need for cognition and susceptibility to anchoring (and Figure 1, p. 5 labels the moderator replication 'no signal - inconsistent'), whereas shipped 'mixed' conflates robust main anchoring effects with the failed moderator hypothesis.
